turns.answer:
If your priority is keeping your iPhone cool while charging, I'd focus on a 3-in-1 MagSafe-compatible station with active cooling (a built-in fan) rather than simply buying the fastest 25W charger.

Heat is especially important when charging an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods overnight or when using StandBy mode.

My recommendation is to prioritize:

Active cooling: A fan that cools the phone during wireless charging.

Qi2 or certified MagSafe: Better magnetic alignment and reliable charging.

Temperature management: A charger that reduces power when temperatures rise.

Low fan noise: Especially important on a bedside table.

Best 3 charging stations for cooling
Best overall value

ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W

$99.99

Built-in cooling fan, 25W Qi2 charging, and a 50W adapter included. ESR claims an average 6.5°F reduction in temperature. Macworld rated it highly for charging performance.

Fan rated below 25 dB; can be switched off.

Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 25W

$129.95

ChillBoost active cooling, adjustable phone angle, and 25W Qi2 charging. An independent test measured an 8°F lower phone-surface temperature with the fan running.

Anker Prime 3-in-1 AirCool

I'd buy the ESR CryoBoost 25W for most situations. It has a strong combination of cooling, speed, price, and independent review evidence. If keeping the phone as cool as possible matters more than cost, I'd consider the Anker, although I haven't found a controlled head-to-head temperature test proving it runs cooler than the ESR.

One important detail: turning off the fan for silent nighttime charging also disables active cooling.

Which iPhone do you have — 15, 16, 17, or another model? That will help determine whether a 25W charger is worthwhile and which cooling design makes the most sense.
